name: Eoseooseyo! Sharehouse-e!
source:
Living your life as an unemployed bum.

After failing the SATs, you're holded up in the corner of your room wasting time watching anime and playing games.

As you are suddenly forced to move out to a sharehouse in Seoul by your parents, 

You come into an unexpected encounter with three housemates.

But the only problem is that...

They are all girls???

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496340/]Steam[/url]]
